attribution: Facts manually transcribed from the canonical official Chelsea FC and Liverpool FC match-report pages listed in official-sources.json. No minutes or assists are inferred.

coverage.completeness_note: Only five completed Chelsea FC and one completed Liverpool FC preseason reports were manually verified. Other current FPL teams, players absent from these reports, and non-current-FPL lineup names are not represented; this is not season-wide completeness.
coverage.unmapped_players_semantics: null means the non-current-FPL names in each report were not exhaustively enumerated; records contain current-FPL mappings only.
